name: Accentle
what: Daily web game: hear a voice, guess where on the map it comes from. Also pass-the-phone mode (up to 10) and party room (up to 24 phones), plus a pub/venue licence
pricing: Free daily game. Day Pass $1.99/24h; Pass $4.99/mo; Pub License $7.99/mo for 3 months then $19.99/mo
funding: UNVERIFIED (press page says it is made by one developer)
scoring_method: Guess scored by map distance (points); the player's own voice is not scored
standout: Wordle-style daily sharing, plus a party/pub mode that already makes money
notes: Read from the press page. This is the closest 'GeoGuessr for accents' product, but players listen and guess; they do not speak

name: DialectGuessr
